Results.ReviewText:
Have never owned anything but weber grills (30+ years.) Bought this one as a replacement for a very old but highly performant propane grill.

My old grill would fire right up very quickly, simply and reliably. On occasion, with this model of Weber, it will fire up to 250 deg. and not heat up further. The 1st time I used it, we actually had guests over and it was quite an embarrassment. Eventually the food got cooked but the delay was unexpected and socially awkward. I later called your cust service line and a very nice CSR guided me through a methodical process for slowly filling the gas lines/burners before sparking the flame and it solved the issue.  I had not read any instructions because I had used a Weber gas grill for years and saw no reason to use it any differently...pretty straightforward stuff after decades of using a Weber gas grill. I thought this must just be for the 1st use of a new Weber but it happened again last night---fortunately it was just our family this time, but it did cause some delay in getting the food ready. After following the instructions to shut it off for 5 minutes and trying again (this time being more methodical), it did fire up properly.

However, I am also finding that I am having more grease fires than I ever did with the old grill. And of course, that means more flames and smoke--to the point, where it is uncomfortable opening the grill to check on the progress. I smell like a volunteer fire fighter afterwards and the amount of heat and smoke I am exposed to is actually uncomfortable. So not a good user experience at all.
Results.Title: Not meeting expectations

Results.ReviewText:
I’ve had my grill for just a few months now, but it has seen much use.
Whether as a slow cooker/smoker, roaster, or direct heat griller, the temps are consistent.   It may not heat as fast as grills with more burners, but it hasn’t been problematic for me.
The size of the cooking surface limits the food size for slow cooking.  But if your looking for a 2 burner, you’re probably not cooking for more than a few people anyway.
I recommend the iGrill bluetooth unit with food and surface temp probes.  Takes the guess work out of cooking times.
The folding side table makes moving the grill a little awkward, but it’s manageable.
Really like the disposable drip pans, and the cooker surface cleans up easily with a plastic scrapper.
Overall, very satisfied with my grill.

Results.ReviewText: I've bought this to replace my Weber Q and absolutely love it. It heats up hotter and faster than my previous Weber. However the only downfall is that my wife keeps grilling on it so now so I can barely get a chance to use it. I let her pick out the color and she wanted the sapphire. I wanted black but was overruled....oh well. The blue looks awesome though. Only time that I get to use it is for my skewers which is fantastic. Highly recommend the Spirit for the price and warranty. Guess my next grill will be another 10 years from now just like my Weber Q. Anyways go and get a Weber because they last forever....

Results.ReviewText: Had the Q-series before, for years, and loved it.  The E-210 is a big step up and has cooked great from the first use.  Temp is rock solid, and making small adjustments results in fine temperature control.  Love the propane tank weight indicator, and that the design makes the tank and it’s valve easy to access.  Easy to clean, cools off fast.  Reversible grill surfaces for wide or narrow grill marks is a thoughtful feature.  Looks great, and can cook for nine or ten, but is usually just for two.  Love this grill.

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
